description: A TypeScript class implementing a searchable, fuzzy-filtered select list component with theming and ANSI handling.

classes.name: SearchableSelectList
classes.description: A component class providing a searchable, filterable list with fuzzy matching and customizable themes.

methods.name: getCachedRegex
methods.description: Returns a cached RegExp object for a given pattern, creating and storing it if necessary.

methods.name: updateFilter
methods.description: Updates the filtered items list based on the current search input value.

methods.name: smartFilter
methods.description: Performs prioritized filtering of items based on exact, boundary, description, and fuzzy matches.

methods.name: escapeRegex
methods.description: Escapes special regex characters in a string.

methods.name: compareByScore
methods.description: Comparator function for sorting filter results by tier and score.

methods.name: getItemLabel
methods.description: Retrieves the label or value of a SelectItem.

methods.name: splitAnsiParts
methods.description: Splits a string into ANSI and non-ANSI parts for highlighting.

methods.name: highlightMatch
methods.description: Highlights query matches within a text, preserving ANSI codes.

methods.name: setSelectedIndex
methods.description: Sets the current selected index within the filtered items list.

methods.name: invalidate
methods.description: Invalidates the search input, prompting a re-render.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the component as an array of strings for terminal display.

methods.name: renderItemLine
methods.description: Renders a single list item line with optional description and highlighting.

methods.name: getDescriptionLayout
methods.description: Calculates layout parameters for item descriptions based on available width.

methods.name: handleInput
methods.description: Handles key input for navigation, selection, cancel, and search input.

methods.name: notifySelectionChange
methods.description: Calls the selection change callback with the current item.

methods.name: getSelectedItem
methods.description: Returns the currently selected item or null.
